verdict.rationale: Meilisearch's own docs describe a hybrid search capability that combines full-text keyword matching with semantic search, using embedders that automatically generate vectors for indexed documents. The evidence does not show that both strategies are fused within one search request, or how results are blended or weighted. missing for 10: explicit documentation that keyword and vector results are fused in a single query, details of the fusion or weighting mechanism (e.g., a ratio parameter), independent or hands-on corroboration of hybrid search quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run hybrid search — semantic vector similarity fused with keyword matching — in a single query

citations.quote: Hybrid search combines two search strategies: full-text search (matching keywords) and semantic search (matching meaning).
When you configure an embedder, Meilisearch automatically generates vector embeddings for every document in your index.
Combine keyword precision with AI that understands meaning and intent.
